title: About
intro: GambitZone is a chess game designed to help you improve by playing bots and learning from your own mistakes.

engine.offer: We will provide the complete source code of the engine build we distribute to anyone who asks, for at least three years: <mail>{{email}}</mail>

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: No account needed; your progress is stored only on this device. Usage statistics are cookieless and anonymous; no personal data, names, or game content are sent. In school mode, statistics are completely off.
